records.locator: PDF p9/printed p1 design note; PDF p22–24/printed pp14–16 precast box-girder construction drawings and parameter table
records.printed_dimensions: Printed p1 identifies 25, 30 and 32 m design spans; printed p15 parameter table gives L = 25, 30, 32 m and associated layout parameters. A 1600 mm outer depth is dimensioned on printed p14; do not assume the same section throughout the series without checking the other drawings.
